aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer diagnosed during follow-up, including high-grade and advanced-stage disease at diagnosis.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Between baseline and 2012, 1160 cohort participants were diagnosed with advanced PC; among these 462 had high-grade and 281 had advanced-stage disease at diagnosis.
study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Diet, Cancer and Health cohort, with one risk-set-matched control per case.
reason: The abstract analyzes incident advanced prostate cancer arising after cohort enrollment, with high-grade and advanced-stage subgroups. It does not report a total or overall incident prostate cancer analysis. The 27,178 men are the source cohort rather than the nested case-control analytic sample.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Neither toenail selenium nor plasma SELENOP was associated with advanced, high-grade or advanced-stage PC.
estimate_classifications.reason: The selenium row corresponds to explicitly advanced, high-grade, and advanced-stage incident prostate cancer. No numeric effect and 95% CI are reported in the abstract.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
